title: Faster SwiftUI Development in Claude Code: See Xcode Previews Without a Simulator Run
summary: NatashaTheRobot explains a Claude mod that resolves a requested screen and device against open Xcode projects and previews, calls RenderPreview, and returns a saved PNG with a bezel in the session. An iOS team can use the same preview loop for bounded layout iterations while retaining Simulator or device checks for behavior a static preview cannot establish.
takeaway: Resolve preview and device identifiers from the project, validate tool arguments, and return the rendered image to the agent; keep runtime acceptance checks separate from preview inspection.
